title: DeepSeek V4 frontier open-source model under MIT license
summary: DeepSeek V4 is a frontier-level open-source model released under the MIT license, supporting a one-million-token context window. The transcript frames it as roughly 76 percent cheaper than GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.7 on input/output tokens and well-suited to long-horizon agent workflows, tool calling and algorithmic coding.

web_findings.title: DeepSeek V4 Preview Release
web_findings.snippet: V4-Pro 1.6T params (49B active) and V4-Flash 284B params (13B active), both with 1M context, MIT licensed.

web_findings.title: DeepSeek V4 review
web_findings.snippet: Around 91.2 percent on SWE-Bench Verified, 10-13x cheaper per output token than GPT-5.5 or Opus 4.7.
